description: Spec 007 (iteration 3, Annex A lever B.2.1, decision 22): the single change is the problem. Generator 0.3.0 with a second zig 180-300 s after leg 2 starts, and both turns across the line of sight (target 30-90 deg on the other bow); first-zig timing, ranges, noise and dropouts as iteration 2 (configs/iter3-ranges.json). Models: the 2c configuration from scratch (2 x 128 stacked recurrent layers, loss_weight_speed 4, max_epochs 150, patience 6, raw features, same seeds). Dataset seed 204: its own test split decides G2. Scored on validation first (diagnostic; validation rule FR-006).
